contract.observed_horizon: catch-up owns an explicit observed_target_world_time supplied by the caller; it never reads OS time
contract.backlog: remaining_due_steps is derived from accepted P4.2 due_plan and is never independently authoritative
contract.batching: advance_batch applies at most the caller budget and never exceeds P3.8 MAX_ADVANCE_STEPS in one call
contract.large_backlog: backlog larger than one P3.8 call is represented explicitly and can make bounded deterministic progress
contract.fractional_remainder: sub-generation elapsed world time is retained in observed_target_world_time after whole generations are processed
contract.partition_invariance: same canonical start, clock and final observed horizon converge to the same RegionState and catchup hash regardless of valid batch partition
contract.extension: elapsed or absolute horizon may move forward only; rewinds fail closed
contract.identity: catchup_hash binds accepted P4.2 parent, clock hash, observed horizon, canonical region hash, derived remaining debt and completion flag

targeted_exact_attached_godot_evidence.boundary_note: targeted runtime uses a deterministic P3 persistence stub only to exercise P4.1/P4.2/P4.3 interfaces; it is not lifecycle acceptance evidence
